name: Weirdfyre's Legacy
source:
A gloomy-cute cartoon story told through visual novel conversations and text based erotic encounters. A lot of the fellows on this island haven't had sex in a long time, and most of them are very bothered by that.

[From [url=https://portrait-prophecies.itch.io/weirdfyres-legacy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部阴郁又可爱的卡通风作品，通过视觉小说式的对话与纯文字情色邂逅展开故事。这座岛上的许多家伙已经很久没有过性生活了，而且他们当中的大多数人都对此颇为苦恼。

[摘自[url=https://portrait-prophecies.itch.io/weirdfyres-legacy]itch.io[/url]]
